title: calculator-ui (M3) Slices 2–4: onboarding, calculator, result, flip timer, Settings
body:
Plan: `docs/plans/calculator-ui.md`, Slices 2–4 (onboarding with Module 1 unsoftened, the disclaimer, the skin-type picker and quiz, permissions; the Calculator entry screen with inputs only and the banner slot; the Result screen with every figure through `FigureView` and its provenance; `SunscreenAlternativeSheet`; `ManualLocationSheet`; the flip timer; Settings with the ceiling selector, the sensitivity sentence, override and reset, export, import, delete, attribution). Stacked on `feat/learn-tab-2`. 457 Linux tests; S11 and S15 pass on Linux.

All UI, not compiled here — first compiler is the macOS job; expect fix rounds. Assembly: Slices 3 and 4 both reached `App/RootTabs.swift`; the entry screen owns its own navigation stack, so the shell's Settings control sits in a row above it. `PromptScheduler` gained a read-only `authorization()` (the timer must warn before it starts). Copy gap: the answer options in later prompts have no keys — BL-2 on `docs/run-followups-20260903`. No blind test edited.
